summary: Black Mammoth Metals filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated October 14, 2026, announcing approval to list its common shares on the Nasdaq Capital Market under ticker BMMX, with trading expected to begin October 15, 2026. The company filed a Form 40-F registration statement under the multijurisdictional disclosure system, expected effective by 4:30 p.m. Eastern on October 14, 2026, and anticipates removal from the OTC Pink Limited Market. No shareholder action is required; no price, stake, or board recommendation is stated. This is an uplisting, not a special situation.
